status: The L2.5 layout spec for Habitat on the LVGL face: every drawn region names its word or composition, the states rest, meet and empty, Habitat's focus as data in place of nav.mjs habitatMove, the events, the bottom line and the strings
note: The one home of the Habitat numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Habitat) and its wireframes 06-habitat.svg to 06g-habitat-nav.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. Habitat is one mibi up close: the mibi in the living window at the left with its name on a tag under it, its card at the top right, five modules under the card, the strip of bays along the foot.

notes.name tag: the mibi's name sits on a tag under it inside the living window, as on Home, so it does not float and the chrome carries system information only; on Habitat the tag carries the name at 28 px, the names role, because it is the screen's one name. The card does not repeat it
notes.meet box: the resident's box is 304×312, the box the juvenile stood in on the Incubator's hatch (incubator.json regions.juvenile), so the new mibi reads as the same creature across the hand-off's dither
notes.card: the instrument's readout of this one mibi: who it is (species and stage, where it came from, what it remembers), its code, its stamp and its chapters. The species word is the door to the species' guide
notes.modules: Home's `module` build without a lamp: one engraved word and its object. Companion, Bond and Portrait on the first row, Cross (wide, it opens a screen) and Wild on the second; Wild, the act that lets a mibi go, sits last, at the bottom right
notes.strip: one tile per bay: the housed mibis in bay order, then the free bays. Six bays take the full tile (152 wide, the thumbnail and the name); seven to twelve take the compact tile (72 wide, the thumbnail alone, the name on the tag when it is shown). More than twelve is not designed yet
notes.painting: a mibi whose painting has not landed shows its placeholder with the waiting lamp; the words are on the bottom line only. A painting that lands while the mibi is on screen waits for the next fresh draw (Habitat opened again, the strip bringing the mibi back, a wake): never a swap in view
notes.amber: nothing on Habitat is amber: no module, tile or count is a need. The notice is the frame's (what needs the player anywhere)

rules.closedList: station-layouts.md, The derived rules (closed): railCompaction slantTabs pageGrid platePosition listPitch splicePlan guideColumns pipGroups leafArc
rules.listPitch: the plates and the strip's tiles are lists by pitch (first, pitch, grid); the strip's form is chosen by the bay count, full up to six, compact from seven to twelve

initial: by the save and the way in: no housed mibi, empty; arriving from the Incubator's hatch (or Home's ✓ Meet), meet; else rest
stateRule: rest: one housed mibi shown, at rest. meet: the same layout on the first look at a new mibi, from the hatch's hand-off until the first press; the meet ribbon stands in the name tag's place. empty: no housed mibi; the window, the strip of free bays and the frame only. A region with `inStates` exists only in those states; the arm of Bond and Wild is focus.armed, not a state

stage.note: the frame's stage; the Habitat master is to be commissioned

glass.note: no words inside, but the name tag and the meet ribbon

resident.asset: the mibi's standard painting at 304×312 if it has landed, else its placeholder (the stylised rig pass); a juvenile at its own proportions inside the same box

lamp.when: while the placeholder is drawn: the painting on its way, or waiting for the cloud

nameTag.w: the name's width + 32, rounded up to the 8 px grid, at least 96; centred on the axis 296
nameTag.clearance: its top 8 px under the ring's ellipse (feet − 8 to feet + 16: 384 to 408), its bottom 8 px inside the glass (456 + 8 = 464)

meetRibbon.note: in the name tag's place, the one ribbon look; it goes on the first press and the tag shows

mark.at: 4 px after the line's last word, on the line's centre

memoryLine.empty: the line is empty when nothing is remembered

code.text: the mibi's code (genome.codeText), live text, shareable

stamp.live: the mibi's stamp, its read chapters filled

states.read: the plate's edge `bevel`, the read emblem
states.unread: a dotted `bevel` outline, the unread emblem: a bred child's chapter, still a surprise

plates.note: one plate a chapter, in ring order, left-aligned from x 608; no word and no pips on a plate: the focused plate's chapter is the bottom line's context

mibi.asset: the mibi with you, its painting or placeholder at 48
mibi.away: not drawn: it is out with the Companion

states.docked: the solid glyph and the mibi with you

states.notYet: before its first expedition: the dim outline

states.none: no sitting held: the frame's outline
states.held: a sitting held: the gilt frame lit
states.painting: its sitting begun, the crate on its way: the gilt frame, unlit
states.portrayed: its portrait came: the frame filled

faces.asset: face-{mibi}-24 of each adult of its species it can pair with, in bay order

states.alone: an adult with no partner: no faces

states.armed: after the first ✓: the gate ajar

tiles.count: one tile a bay (state.bayCount): the housed mibis in bay order, then the free bays

states.shown: the mibi in the window: fill `hairline`, one step up
states.free: a dashed `hairline` outline, nothing in it, not a target
states.away: the mibi with you while the Companion is away: the outline Companion glyph 16×24 in place of its thumbnail, centred where the thumbnail stands

moment.do: Spend time: the mibi's species moment, from its moving set when it has one; until then the placeholder hops twice, the creature lift 4 px up and back, whole pixels, at 0 and 900 ms. Rewards nothing and shows nothing like a reward. A press after the hold cuts it to its end

swap.do: the ring moved to another tile: the resident cross-dithers to the tile's mibi (lvgl-switch.md §2.7, the dither event); the tag, the card, the modules and the strip's shown tile are cuts on the frame of the key

meet.from: the Incubator's hatch: its 180 ms dither ends on Habitat in state meet (incubator.json handoff)
meet.do: the meet ribbon shows in the tag's place; the new mibi plays its moment once (no hold); the first press removes the ribbon (a cut) and does what it does

read.do: a bred child's chapter read: the plate turns from unread to read (a cut) and the stamp prints the chapter's cells row by row from the top over 300 ms, as on Create's grow

bond.do: the second ✓: the heart goes from armed to full (a cut); the mibi plays its moment (events.moment)

release.do: the second ✓ on Wild: the resident dithers out to the next housed mibi in bay order (none: the empty state, a cut); its tile becomes a free bay (a cut); the message plate says where it went

take.do: a cut: the door shows the mibi taken (docked), the strip's marks change

focus.room: only in the empty state: the ring on nothing, no ring drawn; ✓ does nothing (no ✓ cap)

entry.habitatKey: resident, the mibi last seen (frame.json navigation.roomKeys.habitat)
entry.hatch: resident, the new mibi, in state meet (incubator.json handoff)
entry.homeMeet: resident, the new mibi, in state meet (Home's ✓ Meet)
entry.homeResident: resident, the mibi looked at (Home's ✓ Look at)
entry.visit: resident, the mibi visited (the Book's ✓ Visit, a jump)
entry.backFromCross: cross: the target that led there

selectors.tile.shown: the view resolves it to the shown mibi's tile id; never null while a mibi is shown

focus.primitives: lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1 governs: the edge forms (a name, a selector, nearestIn with ahead, an ordered list), the order of a move and the integer scores on doubled centres; `axis` walks the group's present targets by index and stops at the ends

plate.id: plate.<i>, i from 0 in ring order
plate.enabled: an unread chapter of a bred child that is not sealed

door.enabled: the shown mibi is not the one with you and is not already chosen

portrait.enabled: a sitting is held and sitting.portraitBlock is empty

cross.enabled: an adult with at least one partner (state.crossPartners)

tile.id: tile.<mibi id>, housed mibis only; free bays are not targets
tile.focusShows: focusing a tile shows its mibi in the window (events.swap); the resident target is then that mibi

armed.bond: after the first ✓ on an offered bond
armed.wild: after the first ✓ on a mibi that may go
armed.clear: any key but ✓ clears the arm; the arm never survives a screen change

focus.held: while events.moment, read, bond or release holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent

vectors.note: the column nearest: plate 1 (centre x 676) is nearer the door (656) than plate 0 (628)

keys.pad: moves the ring by focus.graph; on a tile it also shows that mibi (events.swap)
keys.confirm: does the bottom line's action exactly; no ✓ cap, nothing happens; Bond and Wild arm on the first ✓ and act on the second
keys.back: Home, wherever Habitat was opened from; Home's ring lands on that mibi when it is at home, else on the room (home.json, ← on a child of Home)
keys.room: as everywhere (frame.json navigation.roomKeys); the Habitat key on Habitat puts the ring back on the resident

resident.context: strings.residentContext; while the placeholder is drawn, strings.painting (strings.offline while the Caddy is unreachable)

bottomLine.tile: as resident, for the tile's mibi

species.jump: frame.json navigation.jumps: habitat → book, spread guide; ← there reads Library

bottomLine.notice: the frame's notice only (what needs the player anywhere); nothing on Habitat sets one

strings.title: Habitat

origin.rule: a founder: where its pod was found; a bred mibi: its parents

strings.painting: its painting is on its way
strings.portraitOnWay: its portrait is on its way
strings.note: today's words in the frame's zones (station-layouts.md, The frame): a verb phrase of four words or fewer for the action, a label of six words or fewer for the context; no dot-joined parts. The string table's words replace them
